notes.hook: Exciting and suspenseful hook that immediately catches attention with 'city-killer' and 'hid in plain sight'.
notes.clarity: The explanation of why it was missed—heading straight toward us so it appeared stationary—is beautifully clear.
notes.payoff: The revelation of how an asteroid 'hides' by moving directly toward us is an excellent, mind-bending payoff.
notes.visuals: High quality visuals, though the professional observatory shown in beat 8 doesn't match the amateur setup of the discoverers, but it serves the narrative.
notes.loop: The transition from 'sneak up on us' back to 'A city-killer asteroid' creates a solid, coherent loop.

rounds.better_than_last: This Short features a much stronger, more suspenseful hook and a highly satisfying, mind-bending payoff compared to the recent episodes.
